# 본 실행 격자 — step 0.02
# 조건 수: 11 × 11 × 11 × noise 3 = 3,993
#   (lam_type을 both로 하면 ×4 = 15,972)
extends: base.yaml

grid:
  lli:    {start: 0.0, stop: 0.20, step: 0.02}    # 11개
  lam_pe: {start: 0.0, stop: 0.20, step: 0.02, type: de}
  lam_ne: {start: 0.0, stop: 0.20, step: 0.02, type: de}
  noise:  [0.0, 0.001, 0.005]                     # V, gaussian
  noise_seed: 42

run:
  chunk_size: 200
  save_full_timeseries: false
